caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular woven textile pattern set against a plain, off-white background with some scattered brownish marks. The textile design consists of a central checkerboard arrangement with alternating square sections of deep blue and beige, intersected by vertical and horizontal bands of red. The blue squares are richly textured with varying shades and small geometric details. Beige squares contain blue grid motifs and smaller rectangles. Surrounding the central area, a wide border runs along all four edges of the rectangle in red, patterned with lighter red and beige grid and circular or square motifs, echoing the woven texture of the central area. The entire composition is symmetrical, and the lower right corner of the white background bears a small, handwritten signature in red ink that reads "Christoffels."
title: Coverlet (Section)
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
